findings.claim: The new O 1s component is a surface hydroxyl from the transferred proton: the acidic proton transfers to a neighbouring two-fold coordinated bridging oxygen.

structural_constraints.value: H bound to a surface two-fold coordinated O (O2c), forming a surface hydroxyl
structural_constraints.derivation: The authors assign the new O 1s component at 531.6 eV to a surface hydroxyl from the transferred proton. Cross-technique support: FTIR shows formate (FTIR:O1, FTIR:O2) and no undissociated formic acid (FTIR:O3), i.e. dissociative adsorption.

caveats: Not provided by the paper: formate coverage.
